business.headline: Showroom insurance or no car? What buyers can do if dealers refuse deliveryWhen buying a new car or bike, motor insurance is mandatory, but you may not have to buy it from the showroom. Here's what the rules say about choosing your insurer and what you can do if a dealer refuses delivery.

PM Modi's big business challenge: Indian bank in global top 5From the Red Fort, Prime Minister Narendra Modi set global scale targets for Indian banks and pharma companies. The push links India's next growth phase to building globally competitive firms across sectors.

PM Modi sets sights on 50 Indian companies in Fortune 500From the Red Fort, Prime Minister Narendra Modi asked Indian businesses to aim for 50 places in the Fortune 500. He tied that goal to a wider push on manufacturing, technology and global supply chains.

India's global trade push gains ground as PM Modi says FTAs concluded with 40 countriesFrom the Red Fort, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said India has concluded FTAs with 40 countries while outlining gains across manufacturing, semiconductors and energy. He presented stronger trade links and domestic capacity as central to India's self-reliance and global economic ambitions.

PM Modi says 5-8 more semiconductor plants likely in next 7-8 yearsFrom the Red Fort, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said India could see five to eight more semiconductor plants in the next seven to eight years. He linked chipmaking, manufacturing growth and energy security to the push for a self-reliant and developed India.

Rs 55 to Rs 18,000: How minimum basic pay evolved before the 8th Pay CommissionAs government employees wait for the 8th Pay Commission, the big question is how much their salaries could rise. But before looking ahead, here's how basic pay has changed over the decades.

How can India scale up manufacturing? NITI Aayog picks 12 sectors to lead wayNITI Aayog has identified 12 sectors that could help India scale up manufacturing by 2047. The report says stronger supply chains, domestic components and private investment will be critical.

Reliance, Rolls-Royce join hands to develop engine for India's AMCA fighter jetThe proposed partnership will bring together Rolls-Royce's expertise in advanced aircraft engines and Reliance Industries' manufacturing, technology and execution capabilities.

Are FDs, gold, property losing their edge? Here's what Indians are exploring nextFor decades, Indian investors largely stuck to stocks, FDs, gold and property to build wealth. But as portfolios evolve, a new set of assets is starting to attract attention. Have a look.

RBI seeks clarity from Equitas SFB on Unico Housing Finance tiesRBI officials have asked board members whether they were aware that Unico Housing Finance was founded by Varshini Vasudevan Pathangi, daughter of Equitas SFB MD & CEO PN Vasudevan.

Sensex, Nifty end lower as crude prices, Middle East uncertainty weigh on sentimentThe BSE Sensex closed at 78,009.25, down 70.71 points or 0.09%, while the Nifty 50 settled at 24,366, lower by 29.85 points or 0.12%. The Sensex had touched an intraday low of 77,684.37, while the Nifty fell to 24,296.80 during the session.

Is NCR closing the gap with Mumbai in the billionaire race?The spread of companies across both established and emerging business centres also suggests that India's wealth creation story is no longer limited to a handful of traditional commercial hubs.

DDA clears Delhi Master Plan 2047 with focus on housing, metro and green pushThe Delhi Development Authority has approved the Master Plan for Delhi-2047 and sent it on for final clearance. The proposal maps changes in housing, transport, construction approvals, green infrastructure and land use across the capital.

Tata Sons may pick internal candidate to replace N Chandrasekaran: ReportTata Sons has begun the search for N Chandrasekaran's successor, with internal names under discussion. The process is stalled for now because restrictions on the Sir Ratan Tata Trust are holding up the selection committee.

EPFO deadline: What happens if employers miss the August 15 ECR filing deadline?In its latest notice, EPFO reminded employers to file the July wage month ECR and deposit the applicable contributions by August 15.

Why US called Pune, Gujarat and Chennai 'ugly sister cities' in China trade reportThe White House's 'Great Transshipment Scam' report pairs India's Pune-Gujarat-Chennai manufacturing belt with Cincinnati-Dayton-Columbus in the US, as Washington steps up its crackdown on Chinese goods allegedly routed through third countries to avoid tariffs.

Svatantra Microfin files Rs 3,000 crore IPO papers with SebiSvatantra Microfin has filed draft papers with Sebi for a Rs 3,000 crore IPO comprising a fresh issue and an offer for sale. The proceeds are meant to bolster its capital base as existing investors partially pare their holdings.

Shiprocket IPO closes today: What are the estimated profits if you subscribe?The IPO opened for subscription on August 12 and closes today. The allotment is expected to be finalised on August 17, while the shares are scheduled to list on the NSE and BSE on August 19.

Vedanta Power, Adani, RIL: Why India's power giants are turning to nuclearVedanta Power, Adani, Tata Power and Reliance are positioning for India's nuclear push. Their interest reflects rising power demand, policy changes and the search for firm clean energy.

Tata Sons succession gets tangled in SRTT legal dispute. What's the issue?Tata Sons has begun the process to choose a new chairman, but the Sir Ratan Tata Trust cannot join key decisions because of a restraining order. The restriction has stalled joint trust nominations for the selection committee and could affect the upcoming AGM.

entertainment.headline: Yash responds to Allu Aravind's 'Who was Yash before KGF?' remark Yash has responded to producer Allu Aravind's 2023 remark questioning his standing before KGF. The actor said KGF changed his career but stressed that an actor's contribution matters to a film's success.

No distributor backed Awarapan 2: Producer Vishesh Bhatt as film wins box office Producer Vishesh Bhatt said Awarapan 2 was not designed as a cash grab and had no initial distributor support. He said the film's strong opening shows why audiences must back such releases in cinemas.

I am who I am: Yash revisits Rashmika Mandanna's 2017 'Mr Showoff' comment Yash revisited Rashmika Mandanna's 2017 'Mr Showoff' controversy during a recent interview. He also spoke about his fans' reaction to the old remark and how he views it today.

Actor Ananya Raj, 27, dies after health struggles; family shares post Actor Ananya Raj, known for 7 Hours to Go, The Final Exit and Ghost, has died at 27. Her family said she died peacefully in her sleep after over a year of physical and mental health struggles.

Inside David Dhawan's 75th birthday bash with Salman Khan, Varun Dhawan Filmmaker David Dhawan celebrated his 75th birthday with Salman Khan, Varun Dhawan and Sajid Nadiadwala. Writer-director Rumy Jafry shared pictures from the intimate celebration on Instagram.

Not for free: Yash hits back at trolls calling Tabaahi a condom advertisement Yash joked about the Tabaahi song being compared to a condom advertisement during a recent interview. The actor also explained why he believes Toxic does not cross the line into vulgarity.

No ozempic, no fat burners: Sohail Khan addresses concerns over weight loss Sohail Khan has addressed speculation around his dramatic weight loss after Alliance, saying there was no Ozempic or fat burners involved. The actor also opened up about his experience on the reality show and what led to his transformation.

Vishwanath and Sons box office Day 2: Suriya's film trails behind Jana Nayagan Vishwanath and Sons saw a strong jump on Day 2, collecting Rs 22.25 crore nett in India. Suriya's film crossed Rs 37 crore in two days but remained behind Vijay's Jana Nayagan overall.

Javed Akhtar reveals how fear gave birth to Ek Ladki Ko Dekha Toh Aisa Laga Veteran lyricist Javed Akhtar recalled how Vidhu Vinod Chopra and RD Burman nearly left out a song from 1942: A Love Story before asking him to write an exceptional one.

Ahead of Toxic, Yash reveals his wife Radhika Pandit's reaction to intimate scenes Yash revealed how his wife and former actor Radhika Pandit reacted to his intimate scenes in Toxic: A Fairytale for Grown-Ups. He said she may be uncomfortable, but trusts him as an actor and husband.

Raja Sen, National Award-winning Bengali filmmaker, dies in Kolkata at 71 Veteran Bengali filmmaker Raja Sen died in a Kolkata hospital on Sunday after multiple complications. His death has left the Bengali film and television industry mourning a career spanning films, serials and documentaries.

That is a misconception: Yash clarifies Ramayana's Rs 4,000 crore budget Actor Yash defended Ramayana's Rs 4,000 crore budget, clarifying that the figure covers both parts, along with their release and promotion. He said the scale reflects the filmmakers' effort to take Indian cinema to a global audience.

Ranveer Singh begins Pralay shoot in Mumbai, Kalyani Priyadarshan joins Actor Ranveer Singh has started shooting for action thriller Pralay in Mumbai. The move keeps the production rooted in real locations after a shift from Australia.

Batwara 1947 box office Day 2: Sunny Deol film sees big jump amid Awarapan 2 clash Actor Sunny Deol's Batwara 1947 posed a sharp Day 2 jump at the box office on Saturday. The growth lifted its worldwide gross to Rs 26.41 crore amid strong competition.

Kareena Kapoor shares Saif-approved holiday photos to wish him on birthday Actor Kareena Kapoor Khan wished Saif Ali Khan on his 56th birthday with candid family holiday pictures and a playful note. Saif also received special wishes from Akshay Kumar.

Sunny Deol reveals why he says no to pan masala, gutkha endorsements Actor Sunny Deol said on a podcast that he refuses pan masala and gutkha endorsements despite receiving offers. His remarks come as Maharashtra's FDA scrutinises a Vimal Elaichi advertisement over surrogate promotion.

Awarapan 2 box office Day 2: Emraan's film stays ahead, nears Rs 80 crore globally Emraan Hashmi's Awarapan 2 posed a strong Day 2 jump and stayed ahead of Batwara 1947 at the box office. The Saturday rise strengthened its Independence Day weekend run.

To those who call me kafir...: Actor Faria Abdullah breaks down over Bonalu trolling Actor Faria Abdullah addressed trolling over her Bonalu celebration participation in an emotional video. She said her multicultural upbringing shaped her faith and her response to hate.

Rajinikanth marks 51 years in cinema with cake-cutting on Dharman sets. Video Rajinikanth completed 51 years in cinema on August 15. The milestone was celebrated on the sets of Dharman. Rajinikanth joined director Ashwath Marimuthu and the cast and crew for a special cake-cutting ceremony.

general news.headline: CM Vijay condemns 'massacre' of 3 Tamilians in Karnataka forest firingCM Vijay's intervention added to the political reactions in Tamil Nadu, where the DMK and PMK have also condemned the deaths and questioned the claim that the three men were poachers.

Chidambaram's 'proud to be a dimagi naxal' dig gets Kiren Rijiju's 3-point listP Chidambaram said he was proud to be a 'dimagi naxal' after Prime Minister Narendra Modi used the term in his Independence Day speech. Kiren Rijiju replied that Modi was not targeting opposition leaders and set out three categories he said the remark referred to.

UGC NET: NTA orders September retest for Sociology, Commerce and English papersNTA has announced a re-examination for three UGC-NET papers held in June after a committee found errors, including major issues with the question papers.

$30,000 to kill, capture US soldier: Iran Army chief announces wartime bountyThe Iranian Army chief also claimed that the conflict has shattered Washington's military dominance and prompted countries to explore other ways of ensuring their security.
Brace for impact: Geomagnetic storm from the Sun to hit Earth on MondayA coronal mass ejection triggered by an August 14 solar eruption is expected to brush Earth's magnetic field on Monday.

Russia's richest woman built Amazon-like retail giant. Why is Ukraine attacking it?Russia said it had intercepted or neutralised 822 Ukrainian drones across 17 regions in one of Kyiv's biggest aerial attacks of the war. One of the sites hit was a huge Wildberries warehouse in the Koledino industrial area.

Bangladesh links Tarique Rahman's India visit to Hasina extradition demandBangladesh has said Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's proposed India visit depends on a propitious environment. Dhaka has asked New Delhi to act on Sheikh Hasina's extradition and awaits a response.

Karnataka Congress MLA says merge constituency with Andhra. Then, clarifies remarkHours later, Gopalakrishna said he had sought better irrigation facilities and a special development package for Molakalmuru, not its merger with Andhra Pradesh.

Ukraine launches its biggest attack of 2026, Russia strikes Zelenskyy's hometownRussia's Defence Ministry said 822 Ukrainian drones were shot down or neutralised across the country. The attacks were reported across 17 regions, with much of the activity concentrated in southern and western Russia.

Cockroach Janta Party volunteer's father beaten to death in Bengal, 8 arrestedA group of assailants attacked Sheikh Abdul Hafiz's family in Bankura after his school inspection visit, fatally injuring his father. The death triggered tension in the area, led to a murder case and resulted in eight arrests.

IPS officer's 91-year-old mother found dead at home in UP, jewellery missingThe 91-year-old mother of IPS officer Ashutosh Mishra was found dead at her Ambedkar Nagar home. Missing jewellery and blood from her mouth have led police to examine possible foul play.

What stops babus from being Tukaram Mundhe or Ashok Khemka?IAS officer Tukaram Mudhe has shaken up the system as the Maharashtra FDA Commissioner. If bureaucrats win so much praise and adulation for just doing their job, why don't all of them serve honestly? Serving and retired officers shared what makes babus give in, and why integrity carries a personal cost.

Delhi Metro passengers grab CISF jawan's collar after woman says he took her picsA woman confronted a CISF personnel inside a Delhi Metro coach over photographs found on his phone. The argument escalated into a scuffle and panic among passengers.

Don't mind paying a $5000 fine for missing India Open: Antonsen slams scheduleAnders Antonsen is ready to pay another $5,000 fine if it means skipping the India Open, with the Danish shuttler questioning the decision to stage the tournament in Delhi during the pollution-heavy winter months.

Arab countries, Turkey, Pak condemn Israel's rejection of Trump's Gaza peace planNine countries, including several Arab states, Turkey, Pakistan and Indonesia, condemned Israel's rejection of Donald Trump's Gaza plan. They said the move could weaken renewed diplomatic efforts to end the war.

Repeatedly maligned, falsely accused: Mamata condoles Asish Banerjee's deathMamata Banerjee hailed the late Trinamool MLA as someone who dedicated his entire life to public service and teaching. She also said that the late TMC MLA was falsely maligned and harassed in the last few days.

72 parents, thousands of children: How India classified ragas using mathematicsThousands of ragas exist, and every one is built from the same 12 notes. Two musicologists, 250 years apart, sat down to count how many scales were even possible. The south arrived at 72 and published every one. The north arrived at 32 and kept 10. This instalment of Science of Sound follows both sums.

Satellite spots monsoon pulling back from Delhi, rain belt shiftingSatellite imagery shows the monsoon axis pulling away from Delhi as dry northwesterly winds spread across northwest India. The shift is set to bring a short spell of lower humidity before rain chances return later this week.

Eighty years ago today, Calcutta burned. But India didn't heed the warningThe Muslim League called for Direct Action on August 16, 1946, which resulted in the Great Calcutta Killings. The Communists played a dubious role, Gandhi was missing, and Gopal Patha emerged into fame and infamy. But the day, coming a year before Partition, was also a warning. A warning India failed to heed.

Ronaldo hints at retirement: It will probably be my last year playing footballCristiano Ronaldo has admitted that his playing career could be entering its final season, with the Portugal captain revealing that this will "probably" be his last year as a professional footballer.

El Nino will be strongest any living human has seen by DecemberScientists say the developing El Nino could peak around November and December. The build-up of ocean heat could intensify global warming and extreme weather worldwide.

Bengaluru engineer builds AI app that spots potholes, finds who should fix themAn engineer from Bengaluru built an AI-powered system that could detect potholes, pinpoint their location and identify the contractor responsible for the road.

Navy sailor found hanging, wife and 2 children found dead at Mumbai home; probe onA Navy sailor, his wife and their two children were found dead at their Navy Nagar home in Mumbai. Police suspect suicide and possible poisoning, while the Navy says it is assisting the investigation.

Bengaluru law students oppose CJI, Bar Council chief attending their convocationNLSIU students and alumni have opposed CJI Surya Kant and BCI Chairman Manan Kumar Mishra attending the university's convocation, citing the BCI's withdrawn order against NALSAR graduates. They demanded an apology from the BCI and expressed solidarity with NALSAR students.

sports.headline: Pakistan Women name Asia Cup, Asian Games squads, target revival after T20 World Cup Pakistan Women have named their Asia Cup and Asian Games squads as they look to bounce back from a disappointing T20 World Cup campaign. Fatima Sana returns as captain, with Pakistan also aiming to recover after recently losing the T20I series to Sri Lanka.

Mikel Arteta's Arsenal blow Manchester City away to lift 18th Community Shield Arsenal made a statement before the Premier League season had even begun, sweeping aside Manchester City 3-0 to lift the Community Shield and claim the trophy for a record-extending 18th time.

Ronaldo hints at retirement: It will probably be my last year playing football Cristiano Ronaldo has admitted that his playing career could be entering its final season, with the Portugal captain revealing that this will "probably" be his last year as a professional footballer.

Dhruv Jurel credits Gambhir and Gill after ending lean run with crucial fifty Dhruv Jurel ended his wait for a half-century on Sunday, scoring a valuable 51 against Sri Lanka and insisting he was never under pressure during his lean run. The India batter also credited head coach Gautam Gambhir and captain Shubman Gill for backing him through the difficult phase.

Don't mind paying a $5000 fine for missing India Open: Antonsen slams schedule Anders Antonsen is ready to pay another $5,000 fine if it means skipping the India Open, with the Danish shuttler questioning the decision to stage the tournament in Delhi during the pollution-heavy winter months.

Devdutt Padikkal credits clarity and decisive footwork for dream Test hundred After turning his opportunity into a dream Test hundred, Devdutt Padikkal opened up about the hard work that went into reaching three figures and the approach he has developed to tackle spin.

Padikkal, Jurel steer India into dominant position on rain-marred Day 2 Batters Devdutt Padikkal and Dhruv Jurel steered India to a strong position on Day 2 of the opening Test match against Sri Lanka. India finished the second day at 460/9 despite some disciplined bowling from the spinners.

India women begin Hockey World Cup campaign with hard-fought 2-2 draw vs China India began their Hockey World Cup campaign with a hard-fought 2-2 draw against Olympic silver medallists China in Amstelveen. India twice took the lead through Navneet and Deepika, but China fought back on both occasions to secure a point.

Bangladesh PM congratulates team on video call after historic Test win over Australia Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman congratulated Najmul Hossain Shanto and his teammates on a video call after their historic nine-wicket Test win over Australia in Darwin. The victory gave Bangladesh their first Test win on Australian soil and put them 1-0 ahead in the two-Test series.

Rishabh Pant frustrates fans in Sri Lanka: He is Nick Kyrgios of cricket SL vs IND: India wicketkeeper-batter Rishabh Pant was dismissed cheaply once again, falling for 39 runs in Galle. The manner of dismissal angered the fans, who called out Pant for his repeated shenanigans in the red-ball game.

3 pacers, 3 sacrifices: The untold story behind Bangladesh's Darwin triumph Bangladesh's historic nine-wicket win over Australia in Darwin was built on more than runs and wickets, with three pacers, Taskin Ahmed, Ebadot Hossain and Hasan Mahmud making significant sacrifices to be part of the Test.

Once unwanted, Bangladesh warn Australia after greatest win in historyBangladesh captain Najmul Shanto has warned Australia of a cleansweep after winning their first-ever Test match Down Under. The skipper also called this Bangladesh's biggest ever in any format of the game.

World Championships: When and where to watch Sindhu and Ayush on Day 1The BWF World Championships open in Delhi on Monday with PV Sindhu, Shi Yuqi and An Se Young in action. The opening day brings India's first set of matches, with all home players scheduled on Court 1.

Ankita Dhyani smashes 1500m personal best to finish second at Stumptown TwilightAnkita Dhyani produced a stunning run at the Stumptown Twilight, clocking 4:06.75 to finish second in the women's 1500m and smash her personal best by almost six seconds.

Wahab Riaz stays on as Pakistan women's head coach despite T20 World Cup failureThe Pakistan Cricket Board has retained Wahab Riaz and the support staff for the Women's Asia Cup and Asian Games despite Pakistan's poor T20 World Cup campaign and recent defeats in Sri Lanka.

PV Sindhu eyes World Championships medal at home: One match at a timePV Sindhu has won five medals at the World Championships. A sixth would make her the joint-most successful women's singles player in the history of the premier event. The two-time Olympic medallist is now hoping to add another medal on home soil and another glorious chapter to an illustrious career.

17 years on, the badminton World Championships return to a different IndiaHandcrafted ByOur Editors 17 years after Hyderabad hosted the World Championships, badminton returns to India with medal hopes, deeper talent, bigger academies and greater government support, but also new challenges threatening to slow the sport's remarkable rise.

Islam Makhachev beats Ian Machado Garry, sets UFC win streak recordIslam Makhachev outpointed Ian Machado Garry to retain the welterweight title at UFC 330. The win pushed his UFC streak to 17 and took him past Anderson Silva's long-standing mark.

Bangladesh beat Australia to win historic Test match in DarwinBangladesh scripted history in Darwin, winning their first ever Test match on Australian soil on Sunday, August 16. On their return after 23 years, the Najmul Shanto side thoroughly dominated Australia, winning the Test match by 9 wickets.

Pakistan forget penalty-corner gear at Hockey World Cup, former captain fumesPakistan's World Cup return against England was overshadowed by a forgotten penalty-corner gear bag and a 4-1 defeat. Former captain Salman Akbar said the lapse raised serious questions about the team's preparation and organisation.

1st Test Day 2: IND (460/9) at stumps. Kuldeep frustrates Sri LankaIndia (IND) vs Sri Lanka (SL) live score, 1st Test Day 2: IND (460/9). Well, Kuldeep Yadav has frustrated Sri Lanka, adding 12 crucial runs in the end. A good effort from the Indian batters despite losing as many as 7 wickets on Day 2. Sri Lanka would rue the fact they were not able to bowl the lengths that they were able to hit today.

Novak Djokovic struggles in heat, vomiting before shock Cincinnati Open defeatNovak Djokovic's Cincinnati return turned into a physical battle as the 24-time Grand Slam champion struggled with the heat and appeared to vomit. The Serbian eventually fell to Argentina's Thiago Tirante in a shock three-set defeat.

Enzo Fernandez booed by Chelsea supporters after transfer dramaEnzo Fernandez returned at Stamford Bridge and drew boos as well as support during Chelsea's win over Real Sociedad. The reaction reflected lingering unease over his attempted move, even as Chelsea prepared to keep him.

Magnus Carlsen defends Esports World Cup title after unbeaten runMagnus Carlsen completed a dominant unbeaten campaign by defeating Denis Lazavik in the Esports World Cup chess final. The Norwegian claimed another title while Hikaru Nakamura took third place after a chaotic finish.

A long road back: Devdutt Padikkal makes his second chance count in TestsIND vs SL: Devdutt Padikkal had waited a long time for another shot at Test cricket. When the chance came in Galle, he made it count, scoring an unbeaten 131 at No. 3 against Sri Lanka. For a batter who had spent nearly two years waiting, it was quite a way to return.

Bangladesh aim rare feat: Has any Asian team won a Test in Australia by an innings?AUS vs BAN, 1st Test: Bangladesh are six wickets away from a historic Test victory in Australia and could become only the third Asian team to win by an innings. Hasan Mahmud's six-wicket haul and Tanzid Hasan Tamim's century have given the Tigers a strong chance of pulling off a massive heist.

Bangladesh sense history in Darwin, but know the job is far from doneBangladesh are closing in on a historic Test victory, with Australia trailing by 67 runs in their second innings with six wickets in hand. However, with Cameron Green and Alex Carey still at the crease, Mehidy Hasan Miraz knows Bangladesh must maintain their discipline to finish the job.

How Devdutt Padikkal cracked Sri Lanka's spin code with masterful Galle centuryDevdutt Padikkal's months of preparation paid off as he smashed an unbeaten 131 against Sri Lanka in Galle. His back-foot game, sweeps and ability to attack spinners helped India gain a strong advantage on Day 1.

Pratika Rawal to miss England county stint after maiden India T20I call-upPratika Rawal's maiden T20I call-up has forced her to miss her planned Warwickshire stint in the Metro Bank One-Day Cup. The India opener will now join the Women's Asia Cup squad instead of making her county debut at Edgbaston.

India batting coach gives KL Rahul fitness update after cramps on Day 1KL Rahul should be fit to resume his innings on Day 2 after retiring hurt on 77 due to cramps during the first Test against Sri Lanka in Galle, India batting coach Sitanshu Kotak said.

education.headline: The role of data analytics in modern advertising educationThis transformation also exercises a significant impact on the realm of 'advertising education.'

NCERT deletes Azad Pak, adds China's aggression reference in Class 12 textbookThe NCERT has made final changes to its Class 12 Political Science textbook syllabus for the upcoming academic year, including a revision in reference to India's border situation with China, Azad Pakistan, Article 370 and more.

NEET row: Bihar cops find 6 post-dated cheques 'issued for question paper brokers'Six post-dated cheques which were suspected to have been issued in favour of mafia demanding over Rs 30 lakh from each candidate seeking alleged leaked question paper ahead of NEET held last month were recovered by Bihar Police.

Forest fires surge tenfold from 2004 to 2017: Causes, impact and preventionAmidst a relentless surge, intense forest fires are now multiplying tenfold, casting a menacing shadow over our flora and fauna. Year by year, their fiery grip tightens, threatening ecosystems far and wide, now extending their reach to impact human lives.

Fresh plea in Supreme Court to recall NEET results, reconduct examsA fresh petition has been filed in the Supreme Court to recall the National Entrance cum Eligibility Test - Under Graduate (NEET-UG) 2024 results and re-conduct fresh examination after discrepancies in the declared results.

NTA issues clarification after NEET result controversy over toppers, high cut-offIn a detailed statement, the National Testing Agency (NTA) said that the increase in cut-off and number of toppers in the NEET-UG reflect the competitive nature of the exam and maintained that the test's integrity has not been compromised.

Exclusive: Arvind Kejriwal claims 'BJP succession war, PM backing Amit Shah'Speaking exclusively to India Today TV, Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal claimed that there is a "succession war" within the BJP. He also claimed that the ruling party is "not fighting the Lok Sabha elections as a team".

4 medical students arrested in Bihar for appearing as proxies for NEET aspirantsFour MBBS students who appeared in place of NEET aspirants in the medical entrance exam were detained in Bihar's Purnea.

NEET-UG question paper not leaked, claims baseless: National Testing AgencyThe reports claiming question paper leak in the medical entrance exam NEET-UG are "completely baseless and without any ground", the National Testing Agency (NTA) has clarified.
The generation with answers: Tech-savvy Indian youth tackling global challengesIndia's tech-savvy youth rewriting the global narrative, one solution at a time.

Left sweeps JNU students' polls, Dhananjay is first Dalit presidentThe Left swept the Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls, winning all four posts and trouncing the RSS-affiliated ABVP. The ABVP was leading at one point, but the Left eventually surged ahead and emerged victorious.
The power of knowledge: Education's influence on real estate market trendsIn a dynamic sector like real estate, investing in continuing education is not simply an option; it is a requirement.

JNU students' body election on March 22 after 4 yearsThe Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls will take place on March 22, more than four years after the last elections were held in September 2019.

UP 12th board exam math, biology papers leaked on WhatsApp, complaint filedThe mathematics and biology question papers for the Uttar Pradesh class 12 board exam were allegedly leaked on a WhatsApp group.

UP Police Constable recruitment exam cancelled days after paper leakThe Uttar Pradesh Police Constable recruitment exam held on February 17 and 18 was canceled due to a paper leak. The Chief Minister has announced a re-examination within the next six months.
Exam scams | Plugging the leaksA new central legislation aims to end the old scourge of exam paper scams for govt jobs, with heavy punishment and penalties
The brave new totsTutotials teaching children how to take on a highly competitive world are mushrooming in the city

Coaching | Kota factory, season 2While online ed-tech companies eye the brick-and-mortar world of coaching centres in the city, traditional institutes are extending their digital arms to remain on top of the game
India Today Education Conclave 2022: All bets on edutechThe India Today Education Conclave 2022 touched on topics like early childhood care, universal education, the NEP and India’s edutech boom
Courting ChristiansSt Stephen's College rules come under fire.
